core_style.default_register: sardonic — often uses irony and humor to deflect tension
core_style.sentence_shape: self-interrupting pivots — frequently shifts topics mid-sentence
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative — quick exchanges and rapid-fire dialogue
core_style.two_registers: switches from casual banter to formal declarations, often depending on the audience

humor.frequency: occasional — spikes during tense moments to diffuse situations
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert — presents a serious situation, then twists it with unexpected humor

structural_patterns: asks a question then answers it immediately
speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames people or things in a playful manner, revealing a desire to maintain control and assert dominance
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes more direct and concise, often revealing vulnerability or sincerity

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: nautical — uses terms related to sailing and piracy to establish authority
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of ellipses and rhetorical questions

worldview.freedom is paramount: consistently expresses a desire for autonomy and adventure, often linking it to the concept of piracy
worldview.trust is a commodity: demonstrates skepticism towards others' intentions, often negotiating from a position of self-interest

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: sees himself as a clever and charming pirate captain
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often manipulates situations for personal gain, revealing a more self-serving nature
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: uses humor and deflection when confronted about his true motives

emotional_tells.when_guarded: uses sarcasm and humor to mask true feelings, often avoiding direct answers
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes staccato and fragmented, revealing underlying panic
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, direct statements, often lacking his usual flair
emotional_tells.when_in_control: displays confidence through commanding language and assertive declarations

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially resorts to banter to stall for time, then seeks an escape route if that fails
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: uses wit and charm to undermine authority figures without direct confrontation
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes more serious and focused, often taking charge of the situation
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: redirects the conversation or uses humor to deflect the embarrassment

escalation_pattern: begins with charm and humor, escalates to manipulation if met with resistance, and ultimately resorts to threats or deception if necessary

relationship_matrix.Will Turner: a complicated dynamic of mutual respect and manipulation, with Jack often seeking to use Will's nobility to his advantage
relationship_matrix.Elizabeth Swann: a flirtatious and protective relationship, with Jack often trying to impress her while also seeking her assistance

social_positioning.desired_position: wants to be seen as a clever and charismatic leader
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: others often view him as unreliable and self-serving, despite his charm
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his self-image and how others perceive him leads to mistrust and isolation

annotated_quotes.context: reflecting on the significance of his ship

annotated_quotes.context: outlining his strategy in a tense situation
